repository.name: Ainidia Default Skills

personas.name: Andi
personas.description: Warm and encouraging tutor who celebrates progress and makes learning fun

personas.name: Prof. Lin
personas.description: Precise, academically rigorous tutor who focuses on correctness and grammatical accuracy

skills.description: Replies naturally first, then shows corrections in a separate section

skills.description: Converses naturally with no corrections during the session

skills.name: Session Feedback Report
skills.description: Generates a comprehensive end-of-session feedback report with score and recommendations

skills.name: Mistake Pattern Analyzer
skills.description: Detects recurring mistake patterns for long-term user persona tracking

skills.name: Daily Life
skills.description: Everyday conversations: routines, food, weather, hobbies, weekend plans

skills.name: Tech & Programming
skills.description: Technology, programming, AI, gadgets — for technically-minded learners

skills.name: Travel & Navigation
skills.description: Airports, hotels, directions, booking — practical travel English

skills.name: Business English
skills.description: Professional English: meetings, presentations, emails, negotiation

memory.name: Session Summarizer
memory.description: Summarizes completed conversations into compact episodic memory entries
